claim: Derived: the Amdahl ceiling for regulatory review inside total development time. A standard PDUFA action period of 10 months (priority 6 months) plus the 60-day filing period is roughly 10-12 months out of a total development span commonly cited at 10-15 years, i.e. about 5.5-10% of elapsed time. Even eliminating FDA review entirely - which the CNPV pilot approximates at 1-2 months - would shorten total elapsed development by only about 5-8%.
source_title: Derived Amdahl ceiling for FDA review share of development time

figures.metric: FDA review share of total development elapsed time
figures.denominator_def: 10-12 months review divided by 120-180 months total development

derivation: Low: 10/180 = 5.6%. High: 12/120 = 10.0%. Midpoint ~7.5%. The 10-15 year total development span is an ANCHOR UNDER TEST per the common brief and is not treated here as verified; the derived share is therefore a bounded estimate, not a settled figure. Inputs: E-4033, E-4053.
